eyebrow: Own yer audio · divvy up it yer way

hero.paragraph: A hybrid, self-hosted shanties ecosystem. Absolute ownership o' yer hoard, wi' th' connected, social streamin' experience - in bit-perfect fidelity.

liveRooms.body: Synchronized listenin' parties wi' chat, votes, an' turn-takin' DJs. Ye hear yer own copy when ye own it; yer hoard relays th' rest.
liveRooms.title: Live listenin' rooms

ownIt.body: Keep yer hoard at port on a NAS or Pi, or run it on a cloud server - either way th' shanties be yers. It streams bit-perfect (FLAC, ALAC, WAV, Dolby Atmos) straight t' yer devices, an' Chordia ne'er stores or routes yer audio.

selectiveSharing.body: Organize shanties into separate hoards - "Ahoy-Fi Archive", "Family Collection" - an' divvy up each one wi' exactly th' hearties ye choose.
selectiveSharing.title: Selective divvyin' up

wrapped.body: Every play be scrobbled t' yer global account an' kept forever - weekly, monthly, an' yearly insights that survive any server move.
